readerCopy.body: A private agreement concentrates money, loyalty, and leverage in the same hands. A merger, inheritance, settlement, intimate commitment, or exclusive contract deepens the bond while making exit more expensive. Venus gives the arrangement value and desire, while Pluto adds control, risk, and consequences that are difficult to ignore. Under the conjunction, attachment and power become part of the same exchange. The agreement may create extraordinary commitment while exposing how quickly closeness changes when one person controls what the other cannot easily replace.
